title: FARLENS Brand Film #000 — Motion Seed Test
known_issues: Section 0 preserves the already-visible locked orange line and adds a restrained tracking light instead of reconstructing the line.
Section 4 motion is deliberately subtle and should be cross-checked in full-frame timeline images when contact-sheet detail is ambiguous.
ceo_decisions_required: Whether Section 0 has enough attraction for the opening five seconds.
Whether Section 4 is strong enough as a mid-film highlight while remaining quiet.
Whether Final feels like the brand remains rather than an advertisement ending.
review_questions: Do the locked compositions remain primary throughout all three tests?
Do connection, organization, and brand remainder read as three distinct motion roles?
Is FARLENS readable and appropriately quiet on iPhone?
